principles: Exclusions are set by drug class using a published criterion, not by drug-by-drug judgment.
An excluded medication is recognized but deliberately NOT assessed. The app must show a message distinct from 'no data'.
Exclusion of these medications does not imply that any other medication is safe. Every result states this.
The app never assumes a clinical indication it cannot establish. Indication-dependent entries resolve to NEEDS_CLARIFICATION.
Matching uses normalized RxNorm ingredient identifiers (IN/PIN RxCUIs), never free-text names alone.

classes.rationale: A small error in dose or quality can cause serious bleeding or clotting. Warfarin and the newer anticoagulants carry boxed warnings for these risks, per FDA labels (not yet checked against current versions).
Levels that drop too low risk organ rejection, and levels that run too high risk toxicity. Clinicians monitor these drugs with blood tests.

administration_rule.statement: Document B: injectable and hospital-administered anticoagulants and immunosuppressants fall under an administration rule that has not been decided.
administration_rule.interim_behavior: Non-oral products are outside MVP formulation scope and resolve to UNSUPPORTED with reason ADMINISTRATION_RULE_PENDING. No rule is invented.
